# Blel Trading PLC

> Blel Trading PLC is an Ethiopian import and export company headquartered in Addis Ababa, Ethiopia. We specialize in sourcing, grading, inspecting, and exporting premium Ethiopian agricultural commodities, specialty coffee, and live livestock to international markets across 7+ countries.

## Core Capabilities & Export Commodities
- **Specialty Arabica Coffee**: Washed Yirgacheffe Grade 1 and Sidamo Natural Grade 2.
- **Livestock (Live Export)**: Pasture-raised Boran cattle, Somali & Blackhead Persian sheep, and pastoral dromedary camels with strict veterinary quarantine and health certification.
- **Pulses**: Machine-cleaned Kabuli chickpeas, Desi chickpeas, green mung beans (Masho), non-GMO soya beans, red kidney beans, and white pea beans.
- **Oil Seeds**: Premium Humera & Metema grade white sesame seeds (Selit) with high oil content.
- **Grains**: Red sorghum grain (Mashilla) and sun-dried maize (Bekolo).
- **Spices**: Ethiopian black seed (Tikur Azmud / Nigella Sativa) and Ethiopian Cardamom (Korerima).

## Trade & Shipping Terms
- **Incoterms**: FOB Djibouti (Port of Loading) and CIF destination ports globally.
- **Export Documentation**: Full phytosanitary certificates, veterinary quarantine clearance, certificate of origin, and certified grading sheets.
- **Pricing**: Export pricing provided on request via formal commercial quotation based on volume, packaging, and destination port.
